recentItems.title: Athletes hit back at sports betting ad featuring Sydney Sweeney
recentItems.description: A new sports betting ad, where Sydney Sweeney wears little to no clothing while posing with sports gear, has gone viral. Olympians and other athletes are now calling the ad out, saying it sexualizes and sets back women's sports.

recentItems.title: Will Iran-Saudi tensions complicate Trump's hope to end war?
recentItems.description: President Trump has said that he wants to end the war in Iran by the midterm elections, but that plan could be complicated as tensions escalate between Iran and Saudi Arabia. CNN's Larry Madowo reports.

recentItems.title: Search intensifies for 129 people missing in Java Sea
recentItems.description: Over 100 people are still missing at sea after a ferry capsized as rescuers battle rough waves to find them. CNN’s Mike Valerio reports.

recentItems.title: Alexander Zverev wins 2026 US Open
recentItems.description: Men’s top seed Alexander Zverev won a thrilling four-set, three-hour and 33 minute showdown with No. 8 seed Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 to win his first career US Open title on Sunday.

recentItems.title: Tech CEOs agree it's time to act on AI. Now what?
recentItems.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s "Pacing the Frontier" proposal is garnering the support of other tech giants like Sam Altman and Elon Musk. Where do we go from here? CNN’s Hadas Gold reports.

recentItems.title: Washington leaders are far from being on the same page over AI
recentItems.description:
Although AI CEOs Sam Altman and Elon Musk, among others, agreed with Dario Amodei's proposal to work together to slow down development of the technology, CNN's Jake Tapper notes that political leaders seem to be far from being in any sort of agreement.

Editor's note: This video has been updated with the city in Ireland where President Trump made his remarks on Sunday.

recentItems.title: Could the US and China go to war over Taiwan?
recentItems.description:
As military drills surrounding Taiwan have become a routine reality, global observers are trying to predict whether Beijing could one day invade the self-governing island of Taiwan. CNN’s Will Ripley explains the factors that could lead to conflict. Stream the rest of "Meanwhile in Asia" on the CNN app.
